abstract.t: In BGP networks, Route Reflectors (RRs) simplify the provisioning of the Internal BGP (IBGP) control plane and mitigate the scaling challenges of maintaining a full mesh of IBGP sessions among border routers. Because of these operational benefits, RRs are widely deployed in modern networks utilizing BGP. This document describes common RR design options, their associated trade-offs, and deployment best practices based on industry operational experience. Operators should consider these suggestions when designing and operating BGP networks because BGP control plane stability is essential to overall network stability.
